title: Interesting Fact Challenge
description: True or false? Test the facts you discovered on the tour.

questions.statement: The path from the Main Entrance leads directly to the Main Building.
questions.explanation: Yes – just follow the path from the gate.

questions.statement: The school garden has a small pond.
questions.explanation: The pond attracts birds, butterflies and dragonflies.

questions.statement: The library is the loudest place on campus.
questions.explanation: The library is a quiet zone for reading and research.

questions.statement: Students learn internet safety in the computer laboratory.
questions.explanation: Internet safety comes before online research.

questions.statement: Sports day is held inside the library.
questions.explanation: Sports day is held on the playground.
